main_text.l: Benedictionis, qua homo homini benedicit exempla: Melchi-sedec Abrahamo, Gen.14.19. Heb.7. v.6.7. Isaac Iacobo, Gen.27.v.4.25. & 28.1. Itaac Esauo, Genesis 27.v.39.40. Laban filiis & filiabus, 31.55. Iacob Pharaoni, 47.v.7.10. Ephraim & Manasse filiis Ioseph,48.v.9.15. Filius suis omnibus peculiaribus benedictionibus, 49.v.1.2. &c. Moses & Aaron Israelitis,Leuitici 9.23. Num.6.v.23.24. Balaam Israeli,Num.23.7.& 24 9. Moses Israelitis, Deuter.33.v.1.2. Iosue Israelitis, Iosue 8.33. Calebo,14.13. BENEDICIT Deus homo Christus Iesus, Matth.14.19. & 26. 26. Marc.6.41.& 8.1.& 10.16.& 14.22.Luc.9.16.& 24.30. 50. 51.Act.3,26.]

¶ Benedictionem, qua creaturæ consecrantur & sanctificantur, ut Sacerdotum, vestium, altarium, templorum, cereorum, aquæ lustralis, campanæ, salis, &c. consecratione stabilire possint Pontificij, probat ex Exo.28.2.& 29.v.6.27. Leu.21.10.&22.2.& 27.v.28.29.30. Nu.5.17.& 31 6. Ios.6.24.
